verdict.rationale: A direct probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.replit.com/llms.txt. The file is structured, with an index linking to a markdown features bundle ('Features (218 pages)'), so an agent can be pointed at it. The docs pages themselves are also served as .md URLs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or recommending the llms.txt / agent-oriented docs, and evidence of a full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt) or of the bundle's depth beyond the index line.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
